The goal of the ALMA-IMF large program is to measure the core mass function at high linear resolution (2700 au) in 15 typical Milky Way protoclusters spanning a mass range of 2.5×10 [3] to 32.7×10 [3] _M_ ⊙ .
The ALMA-IMF large program aims to test if the high-mass slope of the CMF differs from the high-mass slope of the canonical IMF (α = 2.35 when fitted by a power-law, Salpeter 1955).
